description: Logística de Energia is a series of datasets listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Localização das unidades de geração térmica de energia elétrica alimentadas por biomassa do bagaço da cana-de-açúcar, com respectiva potência outorgada (MW). Fonte: SIGEL/ANEEL, 2015. Coverage: Brasil. The portal lists 75 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its tags are Logística de Energia 2015, Redes e Fluxos do Território, Energia Elétrica, Geração de Energia Elétrica, Unidades de Geração Térmica. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
